_about: Public-domain George Herbert (1593-1633, priest and poet) for the Word Hoard: A Priest to the Temple, or the Country Parson clean from CCEL, and George Herbert Palmer's edition of the English Works (Boston: Houghton Mifflin, 1905, 3 vols; vol. 1 a 1915 printing), raw Internet Archive OCR. The poems of The Temple are in vols 2-3. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 8 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
